messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT PAGE — high error rate observed on /v1/generate from canary fleet. auto-escalation to on-call. severity: P1.

incident-bot: Alert details: error=KMS_DECRYPT_FAILURE, rate=24% of canary requests, first_seen=2026-03-15T09:02:11Z. Paging on-call.

sara: on it. i'm on-call eu today — starting triage. which deploy touched KMS/configs?

maria: rolling canary from yesterday’s release (deploy id: deploy-2026-03-15-17). Deploy included key rotation and env var KEY_ID updated. canary pods failing to initialize model cache.

raj: seeing this in canary logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:03:04Z ERROR model-loader failed to decrypt key: googleapis.com/kms: permissionDenied "serviceAccount:redwood-inference@prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com does not have permission to decrypt with key projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/models/cryptoKeys/key-v3"
stack: kms:Decrypt returned 403
```

kevin: confirms — deploy pipeline updated KEY_ID env var and rotated key but the IAM binding step didn't get applied to the prod service account for the canary namespace. looks like a race in deploy job ordering.

ops-bot: Impact estimate: ~5% of traffic routed to canary experiences 500s; user-facing latency/timeouts for a subset of customers on hosted API. No SSO/console impact.

sean: canaries should be isolated but we still route a slice. we need live mitigation: kill feature flag OR rollback canary image + grant temp IAM. which is faster?

raj: fastest is kill the feature flag for the new model route and fallback to stable path; then rollback canary. flag name is experiments.model_v3_canary.

maria: i can do the flag toggle and trigger rollback if you confirm.

sara: go ahead with kill-switch now. post the exact curl and i'll run it. once flag off, divert traffic and start rolling rollback.

raj: command to flip flag (featureflags service):
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://console.redwood/api/flags/experiments.model_v3_canary/toggle \
  -d '{"enabled":false, "actor":"oncall/sara"}'
```

maria: also to immediately reduce blast radius: scale down canary deployment: `kubectl scale deploy/model-canary --replicas=0 -n canary` (will stop new attempts to init).

sara: running flag toggle now.

sara: (after 30s) flag toggle succeeded :white_check_mark: experiments.model_v3_canary now false.

ops-bot: Monitoring: error rate in canary pool dropping to 0 as traffic falls off. customer errors reduced from 24% -> 1.8% within 2 minutes.

kevin: we still need to fix the root cause before re-enabling. temp mitigation options: 1) add IAM decrypt permission to serviceAccount for key-v3 2) re-run deploy with correct IAM step 3) rollback the global KEY_ID env var to previous key id and use older key.

raj: safest is to rollback canary image and re-run the deploy with corrected IAM binding in pipeline. adding IAM inline is faster, but needs auditing. i recommend rollback + pipeline fix to avoid ad-hoc perms.

maria: started rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/model-canary -n canary` — started at 09:07:14Z.

sean: i'll coordinate with infra to patch the pipeline. maria, after rollback, can you hold canary at 0 replicas until we have a tested pipeline?

maria: yes holding. can confirm canary pods are Terminating -> 0 replicas.

sara: updating stakeholders: asking support to hold any customer escalations and publishing temporary status update.

ops-bot: Customer impact summary for status page: ~5% of requests routed to canary experienced 500s from 09:02Z until kill-switch at 09:06Z. Estimated affected customers: low single digits with degraded experiences. No data loss reported.

kevin: infra note: pipeline fix will insert an explicit `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding` step before updating deploy env. snippet: 
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/$PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/models/cryptoKeys/key-v3 \
  --member=serviceAccount:redwood-inference@prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
We'll add a guard to validate binding applied before updating services.

raj: assigning postmortem: i'll own blameless postmortem with maria and kevin. sara, assign an incident reviewer and set P1 doc.

sara: assigning postmortem leads: raj (eng-runtime), maria (eng-infra), kevin (eng-platform). i'll create the incident doc and assign review to @ops-reviews.

sean: on-call handoff: i'm taking secondary oncall for next 2 hours to monitor recovery and validate pipeline patch in staging. sara, handing off to you at end of shift.

sara: ack handoff. i'll leave the canary disabled until the pipeline fix is in place and validated in staging.

ops-bot: Followups: - postmortem in 48h - validate featureflagging safe-mode (automated kill when canary errors exceed threshold) - add pipeline preflight to verify KMS IAM bindings - add playbook entry for KMS-decrypt failures.

maria: creating PR for pipeline fix now. link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4823

raj: thanks all — closing live page at 09:18Z. will reopen if we see regression. :lock: :white_check_mark:
